# 2iSolutions

> SAP consulting and AI-assisted SAP modernization, including SmartForms to Adobe Forms conversion, SAP test automation and ABAP code remediation.

2iSolutions was founded in 2005. Its website describes SAP delivery capabilities, SAP-connected products, industry solutions and offices in India, Canada, the United States and the Netherlands. Project-specific results must be read with their original scope; they are not guarantees for other engagements.
